assets.name: book-cover
assets.display: 3x on Mac (360x456); fit to width on phone
assets.notes: Closed book, T2 storybook lettering: ESME'S FARM. Shown on the right half of the spread when closed.

assets.name: book-pages
assets.notes: Half-page images: even index = left page, odd = right page (index 0 endpaper + 1 contents form the first spread). Each page already has its ribbon banner, set labels (without counts) and is ready for slots. The app draws: the count after each label (pixel font atlas, ink), and for every slot one of: slot-empty + ghost, slot-filled + sticker, slot-filled + sticker + ready-to-place peel. Positions are in pages[] below (page-local pixels).

labels.earned_by: days with a mental health exercise (1/day)

slots.name: Back to it
slots.milestone: habit again after a week off

assets.name: book-turn
assets.notes: Full-spread overlays drawn over the two half pages. Opening: cover-lift, cover-upright, cover-land over (empty left, contents right), then the open spread. Turning forward: show old left + new right under page-lift/upright/land, then the new spread. Backward: the -back frames, with new left + old right underneath.

assets.name: book-spreads-reference
assets.notes: Pre-rendered spreads for checking the layout (pages without stickers or counts).

assets.name: book-slot
assets.notes: Draw at a slot's (x, y). empty = dashed frame (then the sticker's ghost at +1,+1); filled = paper square (then the sticker at +1,+1); ready-peel (2-frame loop) goes over a filled slot whose sticker is earned but not yet placed on the farm.

assets.name: font-small
assets.notes: 4x5 pixel font for counts and labels in the book (uppercase, digits, / - ' . , & ( )). Advance = glyph width + 1.

assets.name: stickers
assets.display: 2x in the nook and monthly review (32 px); book scale in the book
assets.notes: All 170 stickers in book order. Tags = group:set.

assets.name: stickers-ghost
assets.notes: Still-to-collect outlines (sage), same order as stickers.

assets.name: stickers-diecut
assets.notes: Each sticker with a 1px cream die-cut rim, for the earned moment, the flight into the book and the monthly pop-in. Same order.

assets.name: farm-base
assets.display: 2x on Mac (672x368); on phone pan to the highlighted zone at 2x
assets.notes: The whole farm with no characters, no placed animals and bare beds. Draw 'asleep', then for each awake zone copy the 'awake' pixels inside that zone's mask. Beds, characters and the museum door are separate layers (below).
assets.highlight_rule: When a book page is open: every pixel outside its zone mask(s) -> stone if in dark_colours else paper; then draw that zone's outline overlay.

assets.name: farm-zone-masks
assets.notes: One frame per zone: ink where the zone is. Use for waking, highlighting and tap targets.
assets.wake_rule: v2: a zone wakes at about half its stickers placed (phase 1: earned, auto-waking).

assets.name: farm-zone-outlines
assets.notes: Dashed gold/ink outline per zone, drawn on top when its page is open.

assets.name: farm-beds
assets.notes: 8 beds x 6 stages (0 bare .. 5 full; stages at 1/5/10/25/50 to-dos in that area). Draw at bed_positions[area]. The sprout (3) and prize-crop (100) stickers don't change the stage.

assets.name: farm-museum-door
assets.notes: Draw over the farm at (170, 4) until Duvet arrives (120 stickers).

assets.name: ui-book-icon
assets.notes: The little leather book beside the companion in the nook. 'bump' = draw 1px higher. 'glint' = a new sticker arrived (no badge, no number).

assets.name: fx-sparkle
assets.display: same scale as what it surrounds
assets.notes: Generic shine / stick / pop: centre it on the sticker. Frames: burst, burst (shifted), clear.

assets.name: moment-earned-nook
assets.notes: Reference composite (Domino + a sticker + the book icon). In the app, build it from char-domino (idle, happy), stickers-diecut, fx-sparkle and ui-book-icon: 1 arrive, 2 present (happy hop, sticker above), 3 shine (fx-sparkle), 4 fly towards the book, 5 book bumps, 6 glint. Journal stickers wait until she leaves the Journal.

assets.name: moment-into-book
assets.notes: Reference: the die-cut sticker flies in (path and timing are Esme's), sticks with fx-sparkle, settles into the slot (slot-filled + sticker).

assets.name: moment-monthly-popin
assets.notes: Reference: every sticker pops in one by one (Esme's choice), each with fx-sparkle on arrival; drawn frames only, no smooth scaling.

assets.name: moment-ready-to-place
assets.notes: The 'ready to place' corner: loop these two frames over a filled slot until she places the sticker on the farm herself (fixed spots).

bap.note: Bap frames include his lily pad

arrivals.home: Meadow and hives; runs the farm stand
